prompt: Before 2024, among her own record-breaking streaks, in which Olympic event has Katie Ledecky broken the world record the second most times?
answer: The **women’s 800-meter freestyle**—she had broken that world record **four times** before 2024, second only to her record-setting streak in the 1500-meter freestyle.
